device: Apple M4 Max, Metal, 48 GiB unified memory
memory: For each displayed speed the engine must complete both requests and fit the budget. Atomic Engine also verifies its fixed ledger. For llama.cpp the process group was terminated on a sampled RSS/physical-footprint peak or reported lifetime footprint above cap. Poll interval 50 ms. For Splash also account for the separate HTTP process: use the conservative larger of the sums of per-process peak RSS and peak physical footprint (including lifetime footprint); actual process peaks may not coincide. Reduce Splash worker max-memory when necessary. Monitoring does not bound the entire OS file cache.
protocol: Prior matrix supplies every cell except Qwen + Atomic Engine at 24 GiB. The new cell uses the highest mean client TPS among the three rerun strategies. One diagnostic binary and the same grouped BF16 attention kernel were used throughout. Same uncached 4000/64 fixture, BF16 DFlash2 depth 6, first 36 direct layers during prefill. Two fresh processes per strategy, two timed requests per process after 15/8 warmup. Process order is mirrored to reduce order effects. Full reload of four layers is documented in the phase record.
